clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath The Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind, Gakin the Darkbinder teaches the warlock arts in secret. He tests aspiring Alliance warlocks before they attempt to summon and bind demons.

Below The Slaughtered Lamb's taproom, a cellar shelters those who study shadow and fel. The crypt-like room holds summoning circles and grim tomes, hidden from the eyes that watch Stormwind's open mage sanctuaries. Gakin guides young warlocks there, teaching discipline and restraint before they summon forces they cannot control.

Gakin teaches demonology and the rites used to bind demons. Those who earn his notice travel across the kingdom to gather rare things, including stolen bloodstone talismans and corrupt wood from dark forests. When the materials are ready, Gakin oversees their work in the crypt's summoning circle. Novices must master voidwalkers and succubi in trials that test their will and put their lives at risk.
